# 2014: current events archive

**Source-preservation edition.**

This chronological reference preserves 3,720 Wikipedia event assertions across 365 dates, including topic hierarchy, original citations and pinned revisions. SQLite is authoritative; this UTF-8 Markdown is its readable companion.

Source selection and wording are Wikipedia’s, and are not certified exhaustive, impartial or factually correct. Publication does not imply independent checking of every assertion. Original wording, errors and dated reporting figures remain visible. Editorial accounts are separately labeled and cited.

Database: [2014.sqlite](2014.sqlite). Edition SHA-256: `814ceb09fe210346428f3890449ecee9e4c22918a6066f01eb155f53e3206a25`. Publication: `preservation-release-1.0`. Extraction/Markdown profile: `annual-series-1.2`. Date: 2026-10-22.

Original entries without attached citations: 19. These have separate editorial evidence. Full-event reviews complete: 11; partial: 8; without a full-event review: 3,701. Partial reviews leave unsupported details explicit.

Exact original daily files, Wikipedia payloads/metadata and prior extraction candidates are embedded losslessly, with hashes, an exact retirement manifest and Git checkpoint. Wikipedia attribution and CC BY-SA obligations remain applicable. Publisher URLs identify evidence; full publisher articles and images are not reproduced.

Template display uses explicit original arguments without calculated conversions, live expansion or inferred links. Unsupported template markup and source reliability tags remain visible. Orphan topics and malformed/unbulleted material are preserved with the handling notes below; no missing child or event is invented.

Commented-out source assertions remain labeled non-event material in the database and handling notes; they are excluded from ordinary event totals.

## January

### 2014-01-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1102153890](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2014%20January%201&oldid=1102153890>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2014-01-01-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Indonesia exchange gunfire with suspected militants near Jakarta, killing six people.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2014-01-01/indonesian-police-in-shootout-with-terrorists/5180656>).

<a id="event-2014-01-01-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War spillover in Lebanon:.

**Archived source account.** Sources confirm that Lebanon has captured Majid bin Mohammad al-Majid, leader of the al-Qaeda-linked group Abdullah Azzam Brigades responsible for the recent bombing of the Iranian embassy in Beirut, Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Star](<http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Lebanon-News/2014/Jan-01/242826-ghosn-confirms-chief-of-al-qaeda-linked-group-arrested.ashx>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2013/12/31/us-usa-lebanon-idUSBRE9BU0I920131231>).

<a id="event-2014-01-01-0-4"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** Eleven people are killed in bomb attacks outside a hotel in the Somali capital Mogadishu.

Source citations (as archived): [Standard Media](<http://www.standardmedia.co.ke/?articleID=2000101308&amp;story_title=Kenya-twin-bombs-hit-hotel-in-somalia-capital-mogadishu>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/01/01/us-somalia-blast-idUSBREA000E020140101>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2014-01-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Latvia officially adopts the Euro as its currency and becomes the 18th member of the Eurozone.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-25567096>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2014-01-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A three-story building, housing apartments and a grocery store, explodes and burns in the Cedar-Riverside neighborhood of Minneapolis, Minnesota, injuring 13 people, some critically.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2014/01/01/us/minnesota-blast/index.html?hpt=hp_t2>).

<a id="event-2014-01-01-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Indonesia's Sinabung volcano erupts, displacing more than 19,000 people.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2013-12-31/192c000-flee-erupting-volcano-in-indonesia/5180216>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2014-01-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jamal al-Jamal, a Palestinian ambassador to the Czech Republic, is killed in an explosion near his home in Prague.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/01/01/us-czech-palestinian-idUSBREA0008E20140101>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2014/01/01/world/europe/czech-republic-blast-palestinian/index.html?hpt=hp_t3>).

<a id="event-2014-01-01-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Catholic priest Rev. Eric Freed was found bludgeoned to death in the rectory of his church in Eureka, California. Suspect Gary Lee Bullock was arrested, and had been jailed, hospitalized and released due to erratic behavior just before the killing. Freed was named by the Vatican as one of 22 Catholic priests and religious who were killed during 2013

Source citations (as archived): [Spero News](<http://www.speroforum.com/a/HPTSLGARLQ52/74667-Vatican-releases-partial-list-of-martyrs-for-the-faith#.UtQsUdJDv9Y>); [Seattle PI](<http://www.seattlepi.com/news/crime/article/Police-No-reason-to-hold-priest-slaying-suspect-5110350.php>).

<a id="event-2014-01-01-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Recreational marijuana stores open in Colorado.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2013/12/31/us/colorado-recreational-marijuana/index.html?hpt=hp_t3>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2014-01-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bill de Blasio is sworn in as the 109th Mayor of New York City.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2014/01/01/deblasio-sworn-in/4274669/>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2014-01-01-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In front of a crowd of 105,491 at Michigan Stadium in Ann Arbor, Michigan, potentially the largest ever to attend an ice hockey game, the Toronto Maple Leafs defeat the Detroit Red Wings 3–2 after a shootout in the 2014 NHL Winter Classic.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://scores.espn.go.com/nhl/recap?gameId=400484853>).

<a id="event-2014-01-01-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Michael van Gerwen wins the 2014 PDC World Darts Championship by defeating Peter Wright.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sports](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/darts/25571704>).

### 2014-01-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1104701939](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2014%20January%202&oldid=1104701939>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2014-01-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013):.

**Archived source account.** Armed tribesmen and ISIS militants control the Iraqi cities of Fallujah and Ramadi, after days of violence that erupted as a protest camp was removed.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Bawaba](<http://www.albawaba.com/news/iraq-al-qaeda-544587>); [AFP](<http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5gXlsp54xDr44iU_Xv8xypovuEPyA?docId=8bf4c145-5531-49b6-b4c5-fdc5a391aa4f>).

<a id="event-2014-01-02-0-2"></a>

Context: Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013):.

**Archived source account.** Thirteen people are killed in a suicide bombing in Balad Ruz, near Baqubah.

Source citations (as archived): [Ahram Online](<http://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/2/8/90684/World/Region/Suicide-bomber-kills--near-Baquba-Iraq-police.aspx>).

<a id="event-2014-01-02-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War spillover in Lebanon:.

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed and 20 wounded in a car bomb which hit a southern suburb of the Lebanese capital Beirut.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-25577642>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2014-01-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Swedish Academy releases secret documents of the 1963 Nobel Prize in Literature that ultimately was awarded the Greek poet Giorgos Seferis, revealing that writers such as Samuel Beckett and Vladimir Nabokov were dismissed early in the selection process.

Source citations (as archived): [Svenska Dagbladet](<http://www.svd.se/kultur/svenska-akademien-ratade-immoralisk-succeroman_8864390.svd>).

#### Business and Economy

<a id="event-2014-01-02-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fisker Automotive in bankruptcy, asks the judge to reject the official creditors' committee's plan for an auction. The proposed auction would be based on an initial $24.725 million bid from the U.S. unit of Wanxiang Group, a major auto parts concern in China.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/01/02/us-autos-fisker-bankruptcy-idUSBREA010QH20140102>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2014-01-02-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus plunges off a cliff into a 400-foot ravine in Malshej Ghat, in western India, killing at least 30 people and injuring 10 others.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/world-news/27-die-in-india-bus-plunge-accident-29882968.html>); [MSN](<https://web.archive.org/web/20140104154327/http://news.msn.com/world/bus-plunges-into-gorge-in-india-killing-dozens>).

<a id="event-2014-01-02-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Italian navy rescues 233 migrants from an overcrowded boat at risk of sinking in rough waters in the Mediterranean Sea. The boat was spotted about 80 miles south of the Italian island of Lampedusa.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2014/01/02/world/europe/italy-lampedusa-migrants/index.html?hpt=ieu_c1>).

<a id="event-2014-01-02-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The East Coast of the United States braces itself for the first Nor'easter of the season set to bring below normal temperatures and heavy snow in places and prompting the governors of Massachusetts, New York, and New Jersey to declare state emergencies.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<http://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/local/Noreaster-Tri-State-Forecast-Snow-Storm-New-York-New-Jersey-Connecticut-Inches-Foot-Weather-238427051.html>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2014/01/02/us/winter-weather/>).

#### Politics

<a id="event-2014-01-02-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Israeli Prime Minister Ariel Sharon is in critical condition following renal failure after being in a coma since 2006.

### 2014-01-03

### 2014-03-01

<a id="event-2014-03-01-0-1"></a>

Context: 2014 Crimean crisis, 2014 Ukrainian revolution:.

He receives unanimous support. The Council also demands for President Putin to recall the Russian Federation ambassador to the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<http://rt.com/news/russia-troops-ukraine-possible-359/>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/video/data/2.0/video/world/2014/03/01/newday-pleitgen-russia-okays-troops-ukraine.cnn.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-26400597>); [Associated Press](<https://www.cnbc.com/id/101449482>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2014-03-25-4-1"></a>

Context: Garda phone tapping scandal:.

**Archived source account.** Martin Callinan resigns as Commissioner of Ireland's Garda Síochána (national police) over his "disgusting" comment about whistleblowers made to a parliamentary committee. Callinan had also been involved in controversy over the recent surveillance/bugging of GSOC.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-26730162>); [The Journal](<http://www.thejournal.ie/why-did-martin-callinan-resign-1379772-Mar2014/>).

<a id="event-2014-03-25-4-2"></a>

Context: Garda phone tapping scandal:.

**Archived source account.** As Callinan goes, details emerge that the national police have been involved in phone tapping since the 1980s: the Irish Government establishes an inquiry into the matter.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-26737264>).

<a id="event-2014-03-25-4-3"></a>

Context: Garda phone tapping scandal:.

**Archived source account.** A former Garda is found to have perverted the course of justice on two occasions and admits having cocaine for sale or supply.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ News](<http://www.rte.ie/news/2014/0325/604553-stephen-cooper-court/>).

<a id="event-2014-03-25-4-4"></a>

Context: Garda phone tapping scandal:.

**Archived source account.** A letter titled "Recordings of Telephone Conversations made and retained in Garda Stations" is leaked revealing that Callinan mentioned the telephone tapping to the Department of Justice more than two weeks ago and that the Attorney General knew on 11 November 2013.

Source citations (as archived): [The Journal](<http://www.thejournal.ie/callinan-wrote-to-justice-dept-about-recordings-2-weeks-ago-1381273-Mar2014/>).

<a id="event-2014-03-25-4-6"></a>

Context: Post-coup unrest in Egypt:.

**Archived source account.** Mohammed Badie, the guide of Egypt's Muslim Brotherhood, will appear in court with 680 others to face charges of incitement to kill.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-26726901#>).

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2014/03/25/justice/one-world-trade-center-jump-stunt/>).

Editorial date: 2014-05-03. Checked: 2026-10-22. The opened passages establish ceremony, date and presenter. The full assertion about the eligible films being from 2013 needs the award-year rules or complete annual report; a separate 2013 Phalke award reference alone does not prove that clause.

Evidence: [President of India](<https://www.presidentofindia.gov.in/shri-pranab-mukherjee/speeches/speech-president-india-shri-pranab-mukherjee-presentation-national-4>); [Government of India, Press Information Bureau](<https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/erelcontent.aspx?lang=2&amp;reg=48&amp;relid=104964>).

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2014-05-09-6-0"></a>

**Editorial account; source review partial.** The NTSB records a May 9 balloon landing attempt, powerline collision and fire near Ruther Glen, Virginia, killing the pilot and two passengers.

Editorial date: 2014-05-09. Checked: 2026-10-22. The opened Summary supports collision, fire and three deaths. The subsequent ascent and falling basket fragments are not established here; Doswell and Ruther Glen location labels are not silently equated.

Evidence: [National Transportation Safety Board](<https://data.ntsb.gov/Docket/Document/docBLOB?FileExtension=.PDF&amp;FileName=On-Board+Image+Recorder+Specialist%27s+Factual+Report-Master.PDF&amp;ID=40421440>).

Original source account: A hot air balloon struck power lines while trying to land near Doswell, Virginia, and catches fire. The balloon ascends again, with bits of the basket seen falling from the sky, killing all three on board.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2014-06-11-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

<a id="event-2014-06-17-1-1"></a>

**Editorial account; source review complete.** National Weather Service surveys document a June 17 EF3 tornado near Capitol, Montana, and several tornadoes including EF2 and EF3 damage in northeast Nebraska.

Editorial date: 2014-06-17. Checked: 2026-10-22. The official surveys substantiate the date, both regions and multiple strong tornadoes; intense is read as a general description, not a new EF rating.

Evidence: [National Weather Service, Billings](<https://www.weather.gov/media/byz/Top10_Events_of_the_Decade_2010-2019.pdf>); [National Weather Service, Omaha/Valley](<https://www.weather.gov/oax/event_archive_20140617>).

Original source account: Several other intense tornadoes touch down in Montana and northeast Nebraska.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2014-06-17-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** South African wild fires kill seven people, five in Kokstad in KwaZulu-Natal and two in the Abaqulusi Local Municipality, as well as destroying thousands of hectares of forest and grazing land.

Context: South Thailand insurgency.

Context: 2014 pro-Russian conflict in Ukraine.

Context: Gaza-Israel conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israel's military hits 34 targets across the Hamas-controlled Gaza Strip in response to the more than 20 rockets that were fired into Israel from Gaza since Sunday. One Palestinian man is killed after throwing a grenade at security forces in the raids.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted2.ap.org/APDEFAULT/3d281c11a96b4ad082fe88aa0db04305/Article_2014-07-01-ML-Israel-Palestinians/id-1f62cebdca2d4c4a89575db60e716697>).

<a id="event-2014-07-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former President of France Nicolas Sarkozy is held for questioning over alleged corruption.

Context: Boston Marathon bombings.

### 2014-07-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1328947804](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2014%20July%2022&oldid=1328947804>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2014-07-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Operation Protective Edge:.

**Archived source account.** For the second time, an inspection by United Nations officials reveals rockets being stored in a UNWRA run school in Gaza. Rockets discovered in a school a week ago were returned to Hamas by UNWRA workers.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/for-second-time-rockets-found-at-un-school-in-gaza/>).

<a id="event-2014-07-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Donbass war:.

**Archived source account.** The International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC), guardian of the Geneva Convention, makes a confidential legal assessment that Ukraine is officially in a war, Western diplomats and officials say, opening the door to possible war crimes prosecutions, including over the downing of Malaysia Airlines Flight 17.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/07/22/us-ukraine-crisis-warcrimes-idUSKBN0FR0V920140722>).

<a id="event-2014-07-22-0-5"></a>

Context: Taliban insurgency:.

**Archived source account.** A Taliban suicide bomber blows himself up outside Kabul International Airport killing three foreign advisers and an Afghan interpreter.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/2014/07/22/uk-afghanistan-blast-idUKKBN0FR0AL20140722>).

<a id="event-2014-07-22-0-7"></a>

Context: Malaysia Airlines Flight 17:.

**Archived source account.** Forensic experts in Kharkiv, Ukraine begin identifying the victims of the crash, with only 200 bodies delivered out of the 282 pro-Russian separatists claim to have sent.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-28429161>).

<a id="event-2014-07-22-0-9"></a>

Context: Iraqi insurgency (2011–present):.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bombing in Baghdad kills at least 21 people.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2014/07/22/baghdad-suicide-bombing/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2014-07-22-1-1"></a>

Context: 2014 Pacific typhoon season:.

**Archived source account.** Typhoon Matmo (Henry) is expected to make landfall over Taiwan en route to eastern China later in the week.

Source citations (as archived): [Weather Channel](<http://www.weather.com/news/weather-hurricanes/typhoon-matmo-taiwan-china-20140719?hootPostID=44c96eb6e5c80966fc7f89209e0691e7>).

<a id="event-2014-07-22-1-3"></a>

Context: 2014 Moscow Metro derailment:.

**Archived source account.** Ivan Besedin is fired as the head of the Moscow Metro as a result of the derailment that cost 22 lives.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/E/EU_RUSSIA_SUBWAY_CRASH?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

#### Health

<a id="event-2014-07-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thirty thousand people in the city of Yumen in China's Gansu province have been prevented from leaving and 151 people placed in quarantine after a man dies of bubonic plague last week.

Source citations (as archived): [Wires](<http://www.smh.com.au/world/bubonic-plague-death-in-yumen-china-sparks-quarantine-xinhua-20140723-zvx4w.html>).

#### International Relations

<a id="event-2014-07-22-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Union agrees to impose new sanctions on Russia, expanding a list of Russian entities and individuals subject to asset freezes and travel bans and threatens to target vast sectors of the Russian economy if Moscow does not act swiftly to rein in rebels believed to have shot down a Malaysia Airlines plane over eastern Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/eu-foreign-ministers-confer-on-tougher-sanctions-against-russia/2014/07/22/05e1d794-1197-11e4-8936-26932bcfd6ed_story.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2014/07/22/world/asia/businessman-wanted-in-fatal-south-korean-ferry-disaster-is-found-dead.html>).

<a id="event-2014-07-22-4-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/health-science/federal-appeals-court-panel-deals-major-blow-to-health-law/2014/07/22/c86dd2ce-06a5-11e4-bbf1-cc51275e7f8f_story.html?tid=pm_pop>).

### 2014-07-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1107016616](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2014%20July%2023&oldid=1107016616>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2014-07-23-0-1"></a>

Context: 2014 pro-Russian unrest in Ukraine:.

**Archived source account.** Pro-Russian separatist commander Alexander Khodakovsky of the Vostok Battalion confirms that the rebels did possess the BUK missile system - believed to have shot down Malaysia Airlines Flight 17 - originating from Russia, and it could have been sent back to Russia subsequently to remove proof of its presence.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/07/23/us-ukraine-crisis-commander-exclusive-idUSKBN0FS1V920140723>).

<a id="event-2014-07-23-0-2"></a>

Context: 2014 pro-Russian unrest in Ukraine:.

**Archived source account.** The Red Cross officially declares the fighting in Ukraine as a civil war. The formal classification means participants in the fighting between government forces and pro-Russian separatists in the east could eventually be prosecuted for war crimes in international courts.

Source citations (as archived): [The Local](<http://www.thelocal.ch/20140723/red-cross-declares-civil-war-in-ukraine>).

<a id="event-2014-07-23-0-3"></a>

Context: 2014 pro-Russian unrest in Ukraine:.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian forces recapture the villages of Karlivka, Netailove, and Pervomaiske in Donetsk Oblast from pro-Russian separatists.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyiv Post](<http://www.kyivpost.com/content/ukraine/ukrainian-troops-free-three-villages-in-donetsk-region-fighting-for-lysychansk-357583.html>).

<a id="event-2014-07-23-0-4"></a>

Context: 2014 pro-Russian unrest in Ukraine:.

**Archived source account.** Two Ukrainian Sukhoi Su-25 military fighter jets are shot down by pro-Russian separatists in Savur Mogila.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.chron.com/news/world/article/2-Ukrainian-military-fighter-jets-shot-down-5640344.php>).

<a id="event-2014-07-23-0-5"></a>

Context: 2014 pro-Russian unrest in Ukraine:.

**Archived source account.** The bodies of crash victims of Malaysia Airlines Flight 17 are returned from Eastern Ukraine to the Netherlands together with flight recorders from the flight.

Source citations (as archived): [Business World Online](<http://www.bworldonline.com/content.php?section=World&amp;title=Netherlands-mourns-as-bodies-of-MH17-crash-victims-return&amp;id=91363>).

<a id="event-2014-07-23-0-7"></a>

Context: Islamist insurgency in Nigeria:.

**Archived source account.** Two explosions rip through the northern Nigerian city of Kaduna killing at least 82 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.yahoo.com/blast-north-nigerian-city-kaduna-kills-several-122045415.html>).

<a id="event-2014-07-23-0-9"></a>

Context: Operation Protective Edge:.

**Archived source account.** United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights Navi Pillay condemns both Israel's military actions in the Gaza Strip and Hamas for "indiscriminate attacks" on Israel, and warns that war crimes may have been committed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-28437626>).

<a id="event-2014-07-23-0-10"></a>

Context: Operation Protective Edge:.

**Archived source account.** Speaking in Qatar, Hamas political chief, Khaled Mashal rejects the current ceasefire efforts and threatens future attacks from the West Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [YNet](<http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4549051,00.html>).

<a id="event-2014-07-23-0-11"></a>

Context: Operation Protective Edge:.

**Archived source account.** A pro-Palestinian protest in Sarcelles, France turns violent as protesters vandalized and looted Jewish businesses and called for the gassing and killing of Jews.

Source citations (as archived): [HuffPost](<http://www.huffingtonpost.co.uk/2014/07/22/france-jewish-shops-riot_n_5608612.html>).

<a id="event-2014-07-23-0-12"></a>

Context: Operation Protective Edge:.

**Archived source account.** A football friendly in Austria between Maccabi Haifa and French team Lille is abandoned after pro-Palestinian protesters storm the field and attack the players.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://www.espnfc.com/league-name/story/1958466/headline>).

**Archived source account.** The Council of the European Union (General Affairs Council) adopts a final decision allowing Lithuania to adopt the euro as its currency on January 1, 2015.

Context: 2014 Pacific typhoon season:.

**Archived source account.** The Hague's Permanent Court of Arbitration says Russian officials have manipulated the legal system to bankrupt Russia's largest Yukos oil company, and jail its boss (Mikhail Khodorkovsky and others). The company's assets were illegally expropriated for the benefit of State companies Rosneft and Gazprom. The Yuganskneftegaz auction was illegal. The $50 billion awarded by the Hague's arbitration court against Russia is the largest arbitration award ever.

### 2014-08-01

Context: Nagorno-Karabakh conflict.

<a id="event-2014-08-01-0-5"></a>

Context: Operation Protective Edge.

**Archived source account.** A 72-hour ceasefire brokered by the UN and United States which began at 08:00 falls apart with each side accusing the other party of breaching the ceasefire. An Israeli soldier is kidnapped and several killed during a suicide bomber attack at 09:30, according to Israeli officials. Ninety-one Palestinians were killed in the city of Rafah south of Gaza according to the Gaza Officials since the Israeli soldier was captured. The UN and USA strongly condemn the attack. The ceasefire was cancelled.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/day-26-obama-calls-for-unconditional-release-of-captured-soldier-un-condemns-hamas-truce-violation/>); [Global Post](<http://www.globalpost.com/dispatch/news/afp/140801/hamas-accuses-israel-violating-gaza-ceasefire>).

<a id="event-2014-08-13-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** In the Philippines a southbound MRT Line 3 train heading to Taft Avenue station derailed and overshot to the streets. The train first stopped after leaving Magallanes station due to a technical problem. Later on, the train broke down altogether, so another train was used to push the stalled train. During this process, however, the first train got detached from the rails and overshot towards Taft Avenue, breaking the concrete barriers and falling to the street below. At least 38 people were injured. The accident was blamed on two train drivers and two control personnel for failing to follow the proper coordination procedures and protoco.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2014/10/04/sweden-becomes-first-european-nation-to-recognise-palestine/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2014-10-04-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** After counting special votes from the 20 September New Zealand general election, the National Party loses its one-seat majority after losing a seat to the Green Party. With the support of ACT and United Future, National still forms a government, albeit a minority government.

Source citations (as archived): [NZ Herald](<http://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/news/article.cfm?c_id=1&amp;objectid=11337042>).

<a id="event-2014-10-04-2-2"></a>

Context: Latvian parliamentary election, 2014.

**Archived source account.** Latvia votes in a parliamentary election; Laimdota Straujuma's centre-right government keeps its majority.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2014/10/04/latvia-s-pm-straujuma-set-for-re-election/>).

<a id="event-2014-10-04-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jean-Claude Duvalier (Baby Doc), leader of Haiti from his father's death in 1971 until his overthrow by a popular uprising in 1986, dies of a heart attack.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2014/10/04/world/americas/jean-claude-duvalier-death/index.html?hpt=ila_c1>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2014-10-04-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Despite ending their 22-match unbeaten streak after losing to South Africa, New Zealand win the 2014 Rugby Championship in rugby union. Also on the final day of the tournament, Argentina defeat Australia for their first win in the competition since joining it in 2012.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC, South Africa–New Zealand](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/rugby-union/29490798>); [BBC, Argentina–Australia](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/0/rugby-union/29495348>).

**Archived source account.** The 2014 Asian Games concludes in Incheon, South Korea with China gaining the most medals.

Source citations (as archived): [The Express Tribune](<http://tribune.com.pk/story/771397/asia-hails-golden-sports-era-at-games-conclusion/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2014-10-05-1-1"></a>

Context: Bulgarian parliamentary election, 2014.

**Archived source account.** Bulgarians vote in a snap election, following the resignation of a Socialist-led government in July; the number of parties in the National Assembly grows from four to eight, and the centre-right GERB becomes the biggest party but falls short of an overall majority. Voter turnout is just about 50%, lower than at any time since the establishment of democratic rule in 1989.

Source citations (as archived): [The Economist](<http://www.economist.com/blogs/easternapproaches/2014/10/bulgarias-election>).

<a id="event-2014-10-05-1-4"></a>

Context: Brazilian general election, 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/blogs/worldviews/wp/2014/10/05/its-rousseff-and-neves-in-brazil-and-a-slap-at-a-polling-station/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2014-10-05-2-0"></a>

**Editorial account; source review partial.** South Sydney records its October 5 NRL final win over the Bulldogs, 30-6, as its 21st premiership after a 43-year gap.

Editorial date: 2014-10-05. Checked: 2026-10-22. The club supports winner, score, date and the first title since 1971. The all-club comparative record is not independently established in the opened passages.

Evidence: [South Sydney Rabbitohs](<https://www.rabbitohs.com.au/content/a-look-back-at-2014>).

Original source account: In rugby league, the South Sydney Rabbitohs win the 2014 NRL Grand Final and with it their 21st title (the most by any club) and their first since 1971, by beating the Canterbury-Bankstown Bulldogs by 30-6.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2014-10-19-0-1"></a>

Context: 2014 investigation of suspected foreign underwater activity in the Stockholm archipelago:.

**Archived source account.** The Swedish National Defence Radio Agency (FRA) reportedly detected radio communication in Russian transmitted on a special frequency used by Russia only in emergency situations from an underwater vehicle in the Stockholm archipelago.

Source citations (as archived): [Svenska Dagbladet](<http://www.svd.se/nyheter/inrikes/english-version-could-be-a-damaged-russian-submarine_4023511.svd>).

<a id="event-2014-10-19-0-2"></a>

Context: 2014 investigation of suspected foreign underwater activity in the Stockholm archipelago:.

**Archived source account.** The Swedish military releases a photo of the suspected vessel in the archipelago of Stockholm.

Source citations (as archived): [Expressen](<http://www.expressen.se/nyheter/suspected-foreign-underwater-activity/>).

<a id="event-2014-10-19-0-4"></a>

Context: 2014 Hong Kong protest.

**Archived source account.** The Hong Kong Police Force and protesters clash violently in the neighbourhood of Mong Kok.

Source citations (as archived): [McClatchy](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/protesters-police-clash-again-in-hong-kongs-mong-kok-neighborhood/2014/10/18/ba98c88e-570e-11e4-ba4b-f6333e2c0453_story.html?wprss=rss_world>).

#### Religion

<a id="event-2014-10-19-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis closes the Third Extraordinary General Assembly of the Synod of Bishops, a preparatory meeting which had as its theme the pastoral challenges to the family, with a Mass at the Vatican—with Pope Emeritus Benedict XVI and about 70,000 in attendance—featuring the beatification of Pope Paul VI, who concluded and implemented Vatican Council II and gained fame for writing the still-controversial Humanae Vitae sexual ethics encyclical.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN/Associated Press](<https://web.archive.org/web/20141019230439/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/pope-beatifies-paul-vi-at-remarkable-synods-end/ar-BB9WDvV>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2014-10-19-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A working human intestine is generated in a laboratory from induced pluripotent stem cells in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [AAP](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/latest-news/working-intestine-grown-in-lab/story-fn3dxix6-1227095611271>).

<a id="event-2014-10-19-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Oort cloud Comet Siding Spring makes a close fly-by the planet Mars passing within 140,000 kilometres.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2014-10-20/comet-makes-rare-close-pass-by-mars-as-spacecraft-watch/5825528>).

### 2014-10-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076216077](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2014%20October%2022&oldid=1076216077>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2014-10-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Swedish submarine incidents.

**Archived source account.** NATO intercepts Russian jets over the Baltic Sea while Sweden's six-day search for a possibly damaged Russian Navy submarine continues.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.dailytelegraph.com.au/news/world/nato-intercepts-russian-jets-over-baltic-sea-as-sweden-continues-search-for-a-suspected-damaged-submarine/story-fni0xs63-1227098799704>); [Europe Online Magazine](<http://en.europeonline-magazine.eu/swedish-search-for-alleged-mystery-submarine-enters-new-phase_360737.html>).

<a id="event-2014-10-22-0-2"></a>

Context: Swedish submarine incidents.

**Archived source account.** Rear Admiral Anders Grenstad, while pointing out that Sweden's military operation is focused on gathering intelligence on a suspected foreign submarine in its waters, stated that military force could be used to make it surface.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-29721461>).

<a id="event-2014-10-22-0-4"></a>

Context: 2014 shootings at Parliament Hill, Ottawa.

**Archived source account.** A gunman shoots a Canadian Forces soldier outside the Canadian National War Memorial, with the gunman later reported dead inside the Canadian Parliament buildings. The incident came hours after Canada raised its terror threat level from low to medium following Monday's fatal hit-and-run attack on two soldiers in Quebec.,

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/parliament-hill-attacked-soldier-shot-at-national-war-memorial-in-ottawa-1.2808710>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-29724907?ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_campaign=bbc_breaking&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_linkname=news_central>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2014/10/22/world/americas/canada-ottawa-shooting/index.html>); [AFP](<https://news.yahoo.com/canadian-soldier-run-over-suspected-islamic-radical-dies-132343525.html>); [Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2014/oct/21/canada-soldier-convert-islam-hit-and-run-quebec>).

<a id="event-2014-10-22-0-6"></a>

Context: Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Air Force claims to have shot down two of the three fighter jets operated by ISIL in northern Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/middle-east/Syria-says-shoots-down-two-of-three-Islamic-State-jets/articleshow/44914318.cms>).

<a id="event-2014-12-01-1-0"></a>

Eight people have been rescued including one person who subsequently died.

<a id="event-2014-12-14-6-1"></a>

**Editorial account; source review complete.** The coroner-derived disaster account places 18 hostages in the Sydney Lindt cafe siege on December 15-16, with police entering early on December 16.

Editorial date: 2014-12-15. Checked: 2026-10-22. The portal December 14 heading differs from the documented local incident dates. Preserve that heading and original wording; the editorial date is December 15.

Evidence: [Australian Institute for Disaster Resilience](<https://knowledge.aidr.org.au/resources/criminal-lindt-cafe-siege-2014/>).

Original source account: At least 18 are held hostage in a chocolate shop in Sydney, Australia. Police stormed the café the following day.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

Source citations (as archived): [The Denver Post](<http://www.denverpost.com/breakingnews/ci_27227306/putin-foe-alexei-navalny-found-guilty-fraud>).

<a id="event-2014-12-30-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In three separate, but connected, crime scenes in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada, a suicidal man kills eight people and then himself.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/news/world/us/nine-dead-in-edmonton-canada-shooting-incidents-1.2051535>).

### 2014-12-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1190265861](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2014%20December%2031&oldid=1190265861>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2014-12-31-0-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bombing in Ibb, Yemen, kills at least 26 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/12/31/us-yemen-attack-idUSKBN0K90JK20141231>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2014-12-31-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States stock exchange reports ending on a gain of 7.5%. It was the sixth year of continued advancement.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/u-s-stock-futures-edge-upward-1420032056>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2014-12-31-2-1"></a>

Context: Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** As Tropical Storm Jangmi (Seniang) weakens, the Philippines death toll reaches 53 people.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/dc32aa3e21ac4e1885ba93eb12efe339/philippine-storm-weakens-leaves-53-dead>).

<a id="event-2014-12-31-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Explosions at a factory in the southern Chinese city of Foshan kill 17 people and injure 20.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/2014/12/31/us-china-blast-punishment-idUSKBN0K903520141231>).

<a id="event-2014-12-31-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A New Year's Eve celebration stampede in Shanghai kills at least 36 people and injures 49 others.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-30646918>); [China Daily](<http://www.chinadaily.com.cn/china/2015-01/02/content_19222400.htm>).

<a id="event-2014-12-31-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Italian coast guard boards and regains control of a cargo ship that had been sabotaged and abandoned by human traffickers carrying nearly 1,000 passengers, mostly Syrian refugees, that was in imminent jeopardy of crashing into land.

Source citations (as archived): [Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/italian-coast-guard-steers-ship-with-hundreds-of-migrants-aboard-away-from-collision-course-1420028650>); [eNews Channel Africa](<http://www.enca.com/world/disaster-avoided-runaway-ship-stopped-italy-900-aboard>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2014-12-31-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A riot breaks out at a New Year's Eve festival in Gisborne, New Zealand, leaving 83 people injured and 63 arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [NZ Herald](<http://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/news/article.cfm?c_id=1&amp;objectid=11380838>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2014-12-31-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of Italy Giorgio Napolitano announces his impending resignation, citing "old age".

Source citations (as archived): [Business Week](<http://www.businessweek.com/news/2014-12-31/italian-president-to-resign-posing-challenge-for-renzi>).

<a id="event-2014-12-31-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of Gambia Yahya Jammeh remains in power after a failed coup attempt while he was travelling outside the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/africa/2014/12/gambia-leader-return-after-coup-attempt-2014123191702890.html>).

<a id="event-2014-12-31-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nur Bekri resigns as the Chairman of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region of China to become the Director of the National Energy Administration, and is replaced in the interim by Shohrat Zakir.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Standard](<http://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/china-shifts-top-uygur-official-from-xinjiang-114123100762_1.html>).

<a id="event-2014-12-31-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** China relieves Sun Chunlan of her post as Party Committee Secretary of Tianjin, China, and replaces her on an interim basis with Huang Xingguo.

Source citations (as archived): [SCMP](<http://www.scmp.com/news/china/article/1671585/confusion-rare-multiple-reshuffle>).

<a id="event-2014-12-31-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** As part of an agreement with Djibouti's Prime Minister Abdoulkader Kamil, the country's main opposition party, the Union for National Salvation, decides to return to its eight seats in the National Assembly after having boycotted it since the parliamentary election in 2013.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.de/djibouti-government-makes-deal-with-opposition/a-18165740>).
